title: Cost (INR)
description: LLM cost burn — per-agent rate, cumulative spend, attribution. Trend-shape window for budget alignment.

panels.title: Cost (INR/hour) by agent
panels.description: Hourly cost-burn rate per agent. Sustained outliers signal prompt regressions or specialist runaway.

panels.title: Cumulative cost today (INR)
panels.description: Sum of cost_inr increments since 00:00 UTC. Compare against the daily ceiling (Pass 3f §D).

panels.title: Cumulative cost this week (INR)
panels.description: Sum of cost_inr over the rolling 7-day window. Founder-track metric for cohort-1 unit economics.

panels.title: Cumulative cost this month (INR)
panels.description: Rolling 30-day cost. Ops-track metric for billing reconciliation.

panels.title: Top 5 cost-burning agents today
panels.description: Sorted table of agents by today's cost. Surfaces which specialist is consuming budget.

notes: Per-user / per-cohort cost attribution lives in logs (CP1 contextvars carry user_id; trace_id correlates the cost-burn span to the originating request) and in agent_actions / mv_student_daily_cost rows. Metric labels stay agent-scoped per D-C cardinality discipline.
Cohort-1 launch cost ceiling: ₹50/student/day per Pass 3f §D.1. mv_student_daily_cost enforces; this dashboard observes.
